observational_unit: synchronized front/side frame pair at one elapsed-video second

feature_extractors.pose: MediaPipe Pose Landmarker Full, float16 version 1; IMAGE mode, one pose, confidence thresholds 0.5
feature_extractors.pose_features: image-plane hip-centered torso-scaled x/y for 22 landmarks 11..32, visibility/presence minimum scores and eight 2D joint angles per view; coordinates below confidence 0.5 become missing; no triangulation or measured 3D claim
feature_extractors.embedding: official MediaPipe MobileNetV3 Small image embedder, full frame, floating output with L2 normalization; frozen weights; no OWAS fine-tuning
feature_extractors.independence: each frame extracted in IMAGE mode without tracking across other frames or folds

cv.splitter: GroupKFold shuffle=True, group membership independent of class labels
cv.purge_rule: remove candidate training rows within <=10 elapsed seconds of any validation/test row in the same recording; also applied in inner CV
cv.primary_summary: pooled out-of-fold predictions, exactly one test prediction per observation
cv.pose_unavailable: fit on rows with at least one detected view in paired mode; abstain if no input view has a detected pose; keep failures in all-observation denominators
cv.episode_limitation: chosen time blocks and purge do not establish independent work episodes

hyperparameters.selection_metric: mean inner-fold macro F1 over fixed component class set, including failures as incorrect
hyperparameters.probability_calibration: not performed; not needed for this benchmark

metrics: high-risk misses and unresolved high-risk counts
baseline: training-fold majority class separately for each component
inference: point estimates for the selected sample; no independent-frame population confidence intervals or causal clothing/lighting claims
limitations: temporal block choices not validated dependence scale
